phase_objective: Research 13 condemned conclusions from 1486 trial. Output: essay outline + citation map. Use to learn pipeline efficiency before scaling to 900.

tickets.description: Extract the 13 conclusions condemned by Pope Innocent VIII (1486) from Copenhaver and PicoDB. For each: Latin incipit, English translation, papal charge, Pico's defense, scholarly references.
sources: C:\Dev\megabase\chats_2025\2025-07-05_Pico della Mirandola Summary.md (focus: Copenhaver's account of Q1-Q13)

conclusions.picos_defense: string or null (if available from Apology)

tickets.notes: Be verbatim. Extract exactly the 13 Q1-Q13 from Copenhaver's account. Record methodology: were some conclusions harder to find than others? Did Copenhaver cite all of them?

tickets.description: Convert harvested JSON into Pico900 format. Assign IDs (H.1.1 through H.1.13). Validate schema.
tickets.instructions: For each conclusion in stage_heretical.json: (1) Assign ID: H.1.1, H.1.2, ..., H.1.13. (2) Create JSON entry matching data/schema.json. (3) Set status='sourced', commentary_status='draft'. (4) Copy fields from harvested JSON. (5) Leave empty: exegesis, scholar_citations (SYNTHESIZER will fill). (6) Set heretical_flag=true, but leave heretical_notes null.
tickets.notes: Validate all 13 produce valid JSON. Check schema compliance.

tickets.description: Research each of 13 condemned conclusions. For each: state the charge (papal), cite Pico's defense (if available), synthesize modern debate (Copenhaver, Dougherty, Howlett, Edelheit). Find 3-4 verbatim quotations per conclusion.

primary_sources: Copenhaver *Pico on Trial* - full account of charges and defenses
Pico's *Apology* Questions Q1-Q13 (if available in PicoDB)
secondary_sources: Dougherty (ed.) *Pico della Mirandola* - essays on Pico's works, heretical context
Edelheit - scholastic sources for heretical ideas
special_research: Liana Saif - Arabic influences on Pico's heresies (esp. Q5 Kabbalah/Magic, if applicable)

heretical_notes.defense: string (Pico's response from Apology, or Copenhaver's account if Apology unavailable)

modern_debate.copenhaver: string (Copenhaver's interpretation: was charge valid? Was defense credible?)

scholar_citations.relevance: string (how this quotation illuminates the conclusion)

methodology_to_record: Which sources were most useful for finding charges/defenses?
Did Copenhaver + Dougherty + Howlett + Edelheit provide sufficient debate, or did you need additional sources?
Were some conclusions harder to research than others? Why?
Any surprises in the scholarship (contradictions, gaps, novel interpretations)?
Did the 'Four Pillars' framework (charge, defense, debate, context) work?
tickets.notes: This is the learning ground for the pipeline. Record all methodology. Token budget is generous (~55k) — use it to find high-quality citations.

tickets.description: Draft essay outline organizing 13 condemned conclusions by theme. Integrate quotations from scholarship. Create skeleton for final heretical essay.
input: S1's methodology notes (what scholars said about each conclusion)
tickets.structure_recommendation: 1. Introduction (context: 1486 trial, Pope Innocent VIII, precedents). 2. Incarnation & Divine Embodiment (Q1-Q4). 3. Eucharist & Transubstantiation (Q6, Q9-Q10). 4. Soul/Intellect/Immortality (Q7, Q11). 5. Kabbalah/Magic (Q5). 6. Other Theological (Q8, Q12-Q13). 7. Historiographical Reflection (what does the trial reveal about late medieval theology?).
tickets.instructions: For each section: (1) State the theme. (2) List the Q numbers. (3) Summarize the charge (cite Copenhaver or papal source). (4) Integrate 1-2 key quotations from scholarship (ensure they're verbatim). (5) Note modern scholarly debate (Copenhaver vs. Howlett vs. Edelheit). (6) Write 2-3 sentences on implications.
methodology_to_record: Did organizing by theme vs. by order of condemnation change your understanding?
Did the essay argument emerge from sources or did you impose it?
Any gaps in the scholarship for specific conclusions?
tickets.notes: Outline should be ready for Ted to review and potentially expand into full essay.

tickets.description: Validate 13 enhanced entries and essay outline against STYLE_GUIDE.md.
validation_checklist: Every scholarly claim has a verbatim quotation (no paraphrase)
Heretical conclusions have 'charge, defense, debate' sections filled
Essay outline is coherent, well-sourced, and cites specific Q numbers
Quotations are exact and accurately attributed
tickets.notes: If any entry fails validation, request revision (don't approve partial work).

tickets.description: Analyze Phase 0 results. What worked? What was slow? What should we change for Phase 1 (all 900 conclusions)?
input: S1 and S2 outputs and challenges
report_sections: Completeness: Did we find all 13 condemned conclusions?
Citation Accuracy: Did SYNTHESIZER's quotations check out?
Scholarship Coverage: Was Copenhaver + Dougherty + Howlett + Edelheit sufficient?
Token Efficiency: Did we stay under 150k? What was expensive?
Methodology: Did 'charge, defense, debate' framework work?
Surprises: Contradictions, gaps, novel interpretations in scholarship?
success_criteria: Heretical entries have charge + defense + modern debate
Retrospective identifies concrete improvements for Phase 1
tickets.notes: If any success criterion fails, iterate before proceeding to Phase 1. Phase 0 is a proof-of-concept for the pipeline.
